restrictions.location: Islington Ave 36 m South of Aberfoyle Cres to 15 m South of Aberfoyle Cres
restrictions.reason: Toronto-TMC: Kenaidan Contracting Ltd. has been retained by the Toronto Transit Commission to deliver the Islington Station Redevelopment project, part of the TTC’s Easier Access III program. The scope of work includes the installation of new utilities, hydro upgrades, construction of a new west entrance to the station, and the reconstruction of the Aberfoyle Crescent and Islington Avenue intersection. To facilitate this work, Clearway has to complete utility work which entails tying into an existing storm maintenance hole at 3 different locations. This work will be from 11pm-5am. During this time, Islington Avenue will be reduced to one lane. Both southbound and northbound traffic will be using this single lane. Traffic for both directions will alternate in using this singular lane. (2) paid duty police officers will be at each side to ensure safe passage of vehicles. Regular existing traffic configuration will be restored by 5AM.

In completion, the building will be a 59-storey mixed-use building with a total of 984 units.
